utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I think the first thing is sorting the donated parts and seeing what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the donated parts first and flag anything that still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the exact drop-off time and where the repairs are being collected. If we can keep the logistics clear, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the exact drop-off time and collection spot? I’d like the logistics nailed down before I agree.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on those details too—once we have the exact time and collection spot, I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’ve been a bit out of it, but I’m happy to help if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that means a lot. I’ll get you the details for the repair drive, and if I forget anything, just remind me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive plans to a few folks and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll spread the word and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — we still need a hammer, a drill, and someone to help sort the donated parts. If you’ve got a minute, I can point you to the busiest spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got a minute—point me to the busiest spot and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m good with that—just tell me the time, place, and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — let’s meet Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and bring gloves, a hammer if you’ve got one, and any spare screws or zip ties.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday at 10 by the community shed with gloves, my hammer, and any spare screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are you still helping with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m still helping with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you handle collecting the donated tools this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you swing by the community center to pick up the spare tools, then drop them off at 14 Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can pick up the spare tools at the community center and drop them off at 14 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Rosa—what still needs to be sorted out?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara — I’d love your help. We still need a final count of volunteers, a quick check on supplies, and someone to confirm the route for pickups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the volunteer count and check the supplies today. If you’d like, I can also ask around about the pickup route.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what’s running low and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll let you know if anything’s running low.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye on the list, and just flag me if you spot anything we need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s still on track, and folks are dropping off tools and spare parts all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I can stop by later and see if they need a hand sorting things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful — I’m sure they’d appreciate another pair of hands. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details before I do anything. What’s the plan, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for checking — the repair drive is for collecting any broken small appliances and kids’ items the neighbors want fixed, and I’m coordinating drop-off times around school pickup. If you can help, I mainly need you to spread the word and let me know what day works best for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I can help spread the word. I’m free after school pickup on Friday; does that work for the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m happy to help, but I don’t have the repair drive details yet—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I just need the repair drive details when you have them—where to drop things off and what parts they’re looking for.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll check and send the drop-off spot plus the parts list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that would help a lot. I’ll keep you updated if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep telling folks and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed a few details, but I’m here now. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. Could you help me sort the donations and keep an eye on the list of needed repairs?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that. Just point me to the boxes and the list, and I’ll keep track as best I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Rey — I could still use help sorting donated tools and checking if any lawn mowers need a quick tune-up. If you’re free, I can point you to the next pile.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free — point me to the next pile and I’ll start sorting the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m pulling the repair drive details together now. If you’ve got any updates or names to add, send them my way and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa — I don’t have any updates or names to add yet, but I’ll let you know right away if I spot anything. Thanks for keeping the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’ll keep things moving and let you know if anything new comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the timing and who’s bringing what first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally fair — I’ll send out a quick note with the time and a simple sign-up for supplies, then I’ll loop you in right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — just make sure the note includes the exact time and any pickup details. Then I can see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure I’ve got the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening. I’m just checking the details before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm the date and where we’re meeting? I just want to make sure I have it right.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive before I commit to anything. Just let me know the time and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in late, but I can help once you lock the time. Tell me when it starts and I’ll bring whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — I’ll set a time and send you the list of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but it sounds like folks are really pulling together for the repair drive. If you’ve got the latest, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it’s been a good turnout so far. I’m still keeping an eye on what we’ve got and what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear. If you find out what’s still needed, let me know and I can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a little fuzzy, but I’d be glad to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you, Oren — I’ll put you down to help, and I’ll send the details for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. Send the details when you can, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive set for?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still pinning that down, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — just send it over when you have it and I’ll work around the school schedule.
